scope: Original 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12; complete standard 2–4-player multiplayer, required scoring two-player Rival and optional standard 20-contract base-box CHOAM; separate 10 Rise of Ix compatibility contracts identified only. Excludes solo, optional Rival variants including Streamlined, six-player, cross-game expansions and later products. Relevant general/Uprising January 13, 2025 FAQ applied.

reading_completeness.method: Each summary section read in its own outer functions.exec/tool invocation with no more than 30 lines; each source section read in its own outer invocation with no more than 100 lines. All outputs were untruncated. Consecutive actual ranges cover every line, including the final unterminated rules line 1205. File lengths and newline state established with bytes.splitlines().
reading_completeness.source_reference_key: rules = authorized main rulebook text; supplements = authorized supplements text; faq = authorized January 13, 2025 FAQ text. Numeric references are one-based line numbers unless explicitly labeled PDF page.

checked_claims.details: Standard 2–4-player rules, required scoring two-player Rival, optional 20-contract standard CHOAM, separate 10-contract Rise of Ix set, and exclusion of optional Rival variants, solo, six-player and expansion rules are consistent.

Checked quantities, CHOAM-only cards and Leader, deck contents, board tokens, Conflict deck tier construction, Leader selection, Objective distribution, initial deck states, Agents, troops and supplies, water, VP and Combat positions, bank and component destinations.

Checked clockwise turns, reveal skipping and Rival continuation, Plot Intrigue timing, card-icon access, one Agent per card, occupancy and Spy exceptions, pre-effect entry costs/requirements, ordering of card/space/Influence effects, Reveal steps, acquisition timing, cleanup and strength timing. Pre-placement Plot resources can pay entry costs because Plot is legal at any point of the acting player’s turn; destination/card effects follow paid placement.

checked_claims.topic: Combat rewards, strength, ties and cleanup
checked_claims.details: Checked unit and sword strength, zero-unit strength, Combat Intrigue eligibility and consecutive passes, marker changes, 2–3 versus 4-player rank payouts, tie cases, winner card ownership and matching, troop return to supply and sandworm return to bank. Also checked repeated tie rules at summary 152 and 251.
Checked three standard Maker spaces, bonus-spice accumulation and collection, round-end trigger, Agent return and first-player movement; two-player first-player exception is separately explained.

Checked troop origin and finite supply, combat-space deployment of all newly recruited units plus two garrison units, sandworm immediate deployment/no garrison, Hooks icon requirement versus effects without that requirement, retained Hooks, Shield Wall protected conflicts and permanent optional removal, reward doubling and exceptions, and mandatory battle-icon matching.

Checked card origins/destinations, five-card refill and replacement purchases, Persuasion pooling/loss, deck reshuffle timing, trash destinations/optionality, Endgame Intrigue and resource tiebreak order, Influence VP loss/regain, track reward versus Alliance VP, and VP sources.

Checked optional placement/recall, available supply and free recall when none remain, restricted placement, observation-post vacancy, Infiltrate only another player’s Agent, Gather Intelligence decision immediately after placement, separate recalls for distinct effects, no double Gather Intelligence, and Spy Agent access without recalling.

Checked control bonuses for any visitor including self and Rival, defensive troop origin, Influence choice and requirements, optional arrow costs/once-per-turn limit and doubling exception, Intrigue types and stolen-card threshold/random selection, draw/discard origins, acquire effect, in-play/Fremen Bond, recall of another Agent, retreat destination and permanent Swordmaster.

Verified Feyd setup/end position, Lady Jessica starting side, Margot/Irulan upward reach of 2 including passing and regaining, immediate Shaddam restriction, and Spacing Guild’s Favor hand-discard distinction.

Checked 20 standard contracts versus 10 separate Ix contracts, two face-up/18 bank setup, optional Leader and added decks, contract replacement and exhaustion conversion, completion conditions, gaining spice from any source for Harvest, immediate and next-acquisition contracts, future-turn restriction after arriving without contract, reward/face-down destination, mandatory completion and simultaneous matching contracts. Printed contract rewards remain governed by their tokens; no unsupported per-token rewards are invented.

independence_statement: Fresh independent source audit of only the exact frozen expanded-iteration-05 summary. I read the complete frozen summary and all three complete authorized source texts separately. I did not read any other summary version, prior audit/reviewer conclusions, repair history, coverage questions/key, reader answers or grades, and did not communicate with readers. I did not assume PASS. I did not edit the summary. The only file written by this audit is source-audit.json; no new renders were needed.
conclusion: No material incorrect claim or important scoped-rule omission found. All 22 standard board spaces, required Rival behavior, standard CHOAM and applicable supplied FAQ clarifications were checked.
